report_text:
Commons Capacity Report (Phase 50)
====================================================

Capacity is not commitment.
Ability is not obligation.
Availability is not allocation.

Observed capacities: 4
Commons represented: dra-001, jammy-house-001, yacypherpunks-001

Observed capacity records:
  - [capacity-001] jammy-house-001 can offer 'meal_preparation' (4 participants, availability: weekly)
      note: Jammy House participants have prepared shared meals on a roughly weekly rhythm.
  - [capacity-002] jammy-house-001 can offer 'overnight_space' (2 participants, availability: on_request)
      note: Two participants have offered overnight space when asked.
  - [capacity-003] dra-001 can offer 'displacement_relief_coordination' (5 participants, availability: occasional)
      note: D.R.A. participants have coordinated relief efforts during displacement events.
  - [capacity-004] yacypherpunks-001 can offer 'translation_support' (3 participants, availability: on_request)
      note: Three participants have provided translation when requested.

What this report does NOT mean:
  - No commitment is implied. A commons may have capacity and choose not to act.
  - No obligation is created. Being able to help does not create a duty to help.
  - No resource allocation has been performed. Availability is not allocation.

This report is advisory. Human review is required before any real-world action.
